assets.caption: Figure 6.2 Flow rate 10 m³/h to 300 m³/h
assets.notes: Nomograph/chart showing pressure drop versus flow rate for carbon steel water pipes at 20°C, covering flow rates 10 to 300 m³/h. Axes include flow rate (m³/h) on bottom and top, and pressure drop (bar/100 m length) on left and right. Diagonal lines represent pipe sizes.
